svg.title: Independent spatial and temporal refinement
svg.desc: A periodic cell-average sine mode provides an exact continuum reference. Exact semi-discrete evolution isolates first-order upwind advection and second-order centered diffusion. Forward Euler at fixed 64 cells approaches its semi-discrete reference with first-order time error.
